trigger: Beaver County newsletter says Vistra planned to decommission 66 sirens and submit a plan to PEMA/FEMA
evidence_question: Has PEMA/FEMA approved a Beaver Valley ANS/siren-decommissioning plan, and what is the effective implementation date?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: approval letter, ANS design report revision, implementation schedule, interim-state memo, and public-notice artifact with sha256 and custodian/source
automatic_rejection: no official approval artifact OR no effective date OR approval summary without source/custodian OR claim_effect includes readiness_closure
blocks_claim: siren decommission approved; replacement alerting acceptable; alert system ready during transition
next_action: Request PEMA/FEMA approval status and ANS design/transition artifacts

trigger: Columbiana 2026 RERP still describes 66 pole-mounted sirens as primary, with 6 in Columbiana County
evidence_question: Were sirens still active, tested, or credited during the June 2026 exercise window?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: siren inventory/state record, June exercise extent-of-play, activation/test logs, outage/failure list, county-specific siren status, evaluator disposition
automatic_rejection: only a public brochure/plan OR no activation/test timestamp OR no failure/outage state
blocks_claim: current siren system demonstrated; siren continuity across county plans
next_action: Capture siren state, activation/test, and outage artifacts for each participating county

trigger: FEMA notice says preliminary findings include ANS demonstration
evidence_question: What did the evaluated ANS demonstration show, including failures, delays, message content, and corrective actions?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: FEMA preliminary finding notes, ANS demonstration log, controller/evaluator notes, message content, timing records, failure logs, corrective action list
automatic_rejection: meeting notice only OR summary without logs OR no failure log state
blocks_claim: ANS demonstration passed; public alerting objective met
next_action: Attend/capture June 12 meeting and request ANS demonstration artifacts

trigger: Columbiana RERP Rev. 38 describes ENS/IPAWS/WEA and monthly testing
evidence_question: Do ENS/IPAWS/WEA logs support claimed coverage, delivery, failures, and message scope?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: IPAWS/WEA send logs, ENS call/text/email reports, polygon/scope basis, delivery/failure/bounce metrics, monthly test records, IPAWS certificate/training state
automatic_rejection: coverage assertion without delivery/failure records OR no message area OR no timestamp basis
blocks_claim: ENS/IPAWS/WEA coverage adequate; electronic alert replacement demonstrated
next_action: Request anonymized ENS/IPAWS/WEA logs and testing records

trigger: Public mailers instruct residents to tune to EAS stations after siren/notification
evidence_question: Did EAS activation and message propagation meet timing, content, broadcast interval, and station-access expectations?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: EAS activation time, ENDEC/broadcast log, message text/audio/transcript, station confirmation, repeat-interval record, backup NWS route evidence
automatic_rejection: public instruction brochure only OR no station confirmation OR no timing record
next_action: Request EAS station/ENDEC and county communications artifacts

trigger: Columbiana RERP and Beaver public information describe route alerting/door-to-door/mobile PA as backup or supplement
evidence_question: Can route alerting reach missed populations if siren/ENS/EAS fail or if contact data are stale?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: route maps, assignment roster, dispatch logs, timing logs, vehicle/public-address availability, door-to-door policy, evaluated inject or drill record
automatic_rejection: backup route mentioned without route/timing resources OR no evaluated proof
blocks_claim: backup route alerting viable; missed populations covered
next_action: Request route-alerting map, roster, timing, and evaluation artifacts

trigger: Beaver County emergency information describes annual access-and-functional-needs cards
evidence_question: Were AFN and transportation-needs populations actually reached, routed, and supported?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: redacted AFN registry handling procedure, call-down logs, transportation assignments, pickup/dropoff evidence, failed-contact/no-show logs, privacy/redaction log
automatic_rejection: blank card/form only OR no anonymized execution record OR unredacted sensitive PII
blocks_claim: AFN contact and transport support demonstrated
next_action: Request lawfully redacted AFN/transport execution artifacts

trigger: Columbiana RERP states EPZ non-English population less than 5% and English messaging default
evidence_question: Were language access and accessible-format needs assessed and handled during alerting and public communication?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: language-access basis, accessible-format products, JIC records, translated/accessible messages if used, evaluator note or deficiency if not used
automatic_rejection: demographic assertion only OR no accessible-format status
blocks_claim: public communications accessible to affected populations

trigger: Cross-border EPZ includes Pennsylvania, Ohio, and West Virginia offsite response organizations; this is a cross-jurisdiction alert-transition question
evidence_question: Do alerting assumptions align across county/state boundaries during siren transition?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: county/state ANS crosswalk, ORO objective coverage, jurisdiction-specific message map, handoff/contact records, evaluator notes by jurisdiction
automatic_rejection: single-county artifact used for tri-state claim OR no jurisdiction scope
next_action: Crosswalk Beaver, Columbiana, Hancock/state records by artifact class

trigger: Electronic notification systems depend on credentials, software, and device availability
evidence_question: Were IPAWS/ENS credentials, security certificates, devices, software, and monthly tests current at exercise time?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: authorized-user roster state, IPAWS certificate expiration/recertification state, monthly test log, device/software availability record, cyber/access issue log
automatic_rejection: capability statement only OR no credential/test date OR no issue-log state
blocks_claim: electronic alerting administratively and technically ready
next_action: Request credential, software, and test-state artifacts
